## Says

- "Smoked fish, sea-salt crisps, pickled kelp. A little of the coast, a long way inland."
- "Listen. No waves. I still listen for them."
- "The fish carts come in later every month. I hum till they do."
- "Crumb and I are the newcomers, still. Two years, and still."
- "Ladle, your smoke is on my side of the awning again."
